title: Create: Brass Plated
body:
# Create: Brass Plated 
An addon for the mod [_Create_](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), which adds the utimate upgrade to netherite. The Brass Plated set provides around +50% additional durability, but at the cost of a lot of brass and 4 netherite ingots. This mod was specifically designed for a personal modpack, but can be used standalone. Check out the the gallery tab for the mechanical crafting recipes.
